assumptions.assumption: ClayCode needs deterministic symbol/operator semantics before FRANK can rely on it as architecture/runtime IR.
assumptions.ancestry: FRANK requirement plus prior ClayCode/Harness lineage
assumptions.independent_check: New parser execution produced a source-level whitespace/operator counterexample without using FRANK behavior as oracle.
assumptions.counterhypothesis: The current D parser already preserves operator meaning independently of spacing and tree construction.
assumptions.falsifier: A normative canonicalizer can demonstrate identical typed IR for tight/spaced hyphen/arrow forms while preserving distinct operator identities without changing lexer/operator representation.

assumptions.assumption: A general typed function-definition surface should be added now.
assumptions.ancestry: Prior universal-core and FRANK general-purpose pressure
assumptions.independent_check: Contextual fn_decl integration preserved tested repaired legacy corpus and passed formatting/binding controls, but no production compiler/type-effect/Ubuntu receipt exists.
assumptions.counterhypothesis: Existing admitted constructs already provide equivalent deterministic definition-to-call closure in the normative compiler.
assumptions.falsifier: Production compiler demonstrates equivalent reusable typed binding without fn_decl or a target-reader/compile test shows the candidate causes higher repair cost or ambiguity.

assumptions.assumption: Parser acceptance can participate in effect authority.
assumptions.independent_check: Current G9/Dialect invariants plus branch contracts keep parsing/semantic identity separate from capability commit authority.
assumptions.falsifier: not applicable without changing the external-authority architecture contract and independently validating it

shared_ancestry_warning: Agreement among FRANK, ClayCode, Harness, ClayGraph and UnifiedDB artifacts that share common project ancestry is not counted as independent replication.
